A spectacular show!|Inventory Description}} {{QuoteBox|Happy 2020!|Former Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Firework''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could be obtained from the [[Event Store]] for {{Tickets|1,500}} during the [[Christmas 2019 Event]]. It could also have been obtained with a gamepass for {{Robux|150}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote is not looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote, though an explosion sound effect can be heard when the firework explodes. You cannot move while performing this emote. '''Firework''' was later re-sold on the 4th of July 2020 for American Independence Day for {{Robux|175}}. It was again re-sold on the 4th of July 2021 for {{Robux|200}}. It was then again re-sold on the 31st of December for New Year's Eve for {{Robux|250}}. It was then again re-sold on the 4th of July 2022 for {{Robux|250}}. It was then again re-sold on the 1st of January for New Year's Day for {{Robux|200}}. It was then again re-sold on the 4th of July 2023 for {{Robux|200}}. It was then again re-sold on the 31st of December 2024 for {{Robux|199}}. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}} Firework.gif|First version (1 January 2020 – 29 October 2020) }} ==Trivia== *This is the second event [[Emotes|emote]] for the game after the [[Lazy Couch]]. **This is also the second event emote to introduce a model into the game, after the [[Lazy Couch]]. *This is the first emote to cost Tickets directly (the [[Lazy Couch]] was indirectly bought with Tickets). *This [[Emotes|emote]], along with the [[Lazy Couch]], [[Frozen (Emote)|Frozen]], [[Raw Dinner]], [[Recliner]] and [[Axe Throw]] emotes, are the only emotes to play global sounds. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text = *'''1 January 2020''' -
